title.zh: 鲸河马类及化石近亲来源限定证据

description.en: Open the Explorer at Whippomorpha to inspect the linked, locator-bearing source claim together with this package's current occurrence context. This is a reproducible evidence entry point, not a phylogenetic result or a complete history of the group.
description.zh: 在探索器中打开鲸河马类及化石近亲，结合本包当前的出现记录背景检查带有精确来源定位的关联声明。这是可复现的证据检查入口，不是系统发育结果，也不是该类群的完整历史。

limitations: The linked claim retains its own specimen, stratum, model, confidence and source-locator boundaries. The Explorer route does not establish an exact origin, global first or last appearance, direct ancestry, causal mechanism or package-specific phylogeny.

description.en: Open a source-bounded Whippomorpha time window in the map to inspect sampled occurrence context linked to this package.
description.zh: 在地图中打开有来源边界的鲸偶蹄类时间窗口，检查与本包关联的采样出现背景。

limitations: The interval follows the linked package range and claim; map markers are sampled records and do not establish a complete distribution, exact origination or extinction, or direct ancestry.

description.en: Compare indohyus and ambulocetus through package-linked claims and bounded occurrence context; this side-by-side route is an evidence inspection aid.
description.zh: 通过本包关联的声明与限定出现背景比较indohyus与ambulocetus；并列页面仅用于证据检查。

limitations: The two sides retain separate source, sampling, range and uncertainty boundaries; visual differences are not tests of evolutionary causation or a package-specific phylogeny.

title.zh: Indohyus 辛德哈图迪骨床地图窗口

description.en: Open the 48–47 Ma Sindkhatudi sample window for Indohyus to inspect sampled occurrence context alongside the locator-bearing aquatic-wading claim. This route is an evidence-inspection aid, not a direct-ancestor or global-range reconstruction.
description.zh: 打开 Indohyus 48–47 Ma 辛德哈图迪样本窗口，在带定位来源的水生涉水证据旁检查取样出现背景。该路线用于证据检查，不是直接祖先或全球分布重建。

limitations: The 48–47 Ma interval follows the available range for the Sindkhatudi bone-bed sample; it is not a global FAD, LAD or continuous lineage duration.
Map markers are sampled records and model context; they do not establish complete distribution, direct ancestry, causal mechanism or exact fossil-to-map co-registration.

title.en: Pakicetus Ganda Kas locality map window
title.zh: Pakicetus 甘达卡斯地点地图窗口

description.en: Open a 50–48 Ma map window for the H-GSP Locality 62 Pakicetus sample at Ganda Kas, Pakistan, and inspect the source-bounded composite reconstruction claim. The route does not turn separate elements into one specimen or an ancestor sequence.
description.zh: 打开巴基斯坦甘达卡斯 H-GSP 62 号地点 Pakicetus 样本的 50–48 Ma 地图窗口，检查有来源边界的组合重建声明。该路线不会把分离标本变成单一个体或祖先序列。

limitations: The 50–48 Ma interval is the available locality-level envelope for separately catalogued H-GSP 62 material; it is not a global FAD, LAD or complete Pakicetus distribution.
The reconstruction and locomotor interpretation retain specimen-association limits; map context does not establish direct ancestry, causal mechanism or exact fossil-to-map co-registration.

title.zh: Ambulocetus 库尔达纳组地图窗口

description.en: Open the 48–47 Ma Kuldana Formation window for Ambulocetus holotype H-GSP 18507 in Pakistan to inspect the partial-skeleton evidence and its inferred amphibious locomotor mosaic.
description.zh: 打开巴基斯坦库尔达纳组 Ambulocetus 正模标本 H-GSP 18507 的 48–47 Ma 窗口，检查部分骨架证据及其推断的两栖运动组合。

limitations: The 48–47 Ma interval follows the available stratigraphic envelope for the named holotype, not a direct numerical date or global FAD/LAD.

Swimming and terrestrial movement are functional hypotheses from incomplete anatomy; map markers do not establish complete distribution, direct ancestry, causal mechanism or exact fossil-to-map co-registration.

title.zh: Peregocetus 玉马科段地图窗口

description.en: Open the approximately 42.6 Ma Lowest Yumaque Member window for Peregocetus holotype MUSM 3580 in Peru and inspect its locator-bearing amphibious-dispersal evidence. The age is a biochronological interpretation, not a direct specimen date.
description.zh: 打开秘鲁 Peregocetus 正模标本 MUSM 3580 所在最低玉马科段约 42.6 Ma 窗口，检查带定位来源的两栖扩散证据。该年龄是生物年代学解释，不是标本的直接测年。

limitations: The point age follows the available nannofossil-based biochronological interpretation for the lowest Yumaque Member; it is not a global FAD, LAD or genus-wide duration.

Locomotion and the westward dispersal route remain functional and phylogenetic interpretations; map context does not establish complete distribution, direct ancestry, causal mechanism or exact fossil-to-map co-registration.

title.en: Basilosaurus Wadi Al Hitan hind-limb map window
title.zh: Basilosaurus 瓦迪阿尔希坦后肢地图窗口

description.en: Open the 37.7–35 Ma Birket Qarun Formation window for Egyptian Basilosaurus material, including UM 93231, to inspect the locator-bearing hind-limb and bone-microstructure evidence.
description.zh: 打开埃及比尔克特卡伦组 37.7–35 Ma 窗口，检查包括 UM 93231 在内的 Basilosaurus 材料及带定位来源的后肢与骨组织微结构证据。

limitations: The 37.7–35 Ma interval is the available broad formation envelope for the sampled Egyptian material, not a direct date on UM 93231 or a global Basilosaurus range.

The specimens support anatomical measurements while functional roles remain inferred; map markers do not establish complete distribution, direct ancestry, causal mechanism or exact fossil-to-map co-registration.

title.zh: Aegicetus 吉哈南组地图窗口

description.en: Open the approximately 37.71 Ma Lower Gehannam Formation window for Aegicetus holotype CGM 60584 at Wadi Al Hitan and inspect the source-bounded vertebral and limb-reduction evidence.
description.zh: 打开瓦迪阿尔希坦下部吉哈南组 Aegicetus 正模标本 CGM 60584 约 37.71 Ma 窗口，检查有来源边界的脊柱与肢体缩减证据。

limitations: The point age follows the available boundary translation for the lower Gehannam Formation amid conflicting stratigraphic evidence; it is not an exact specimen date or global FAD/LAD.

A shift toward tail-assisted propulsion is inferred and no fluke is preserved; map context does not establish complete distribution, direct ancestry, causal mechanism or exact fossil-to-map co-registration.
